answer: A jade-token reputation delta opens each agent's account. Each action draws from a per-agent allowance that grows with the agent's verified interaction history, so a fresh identity starts near zero. Sybil clusters therefore pay a rising marginal cost per sybil: every new identity must first be seeded with costly history before it can act. The jetty is one shared pool of established identities whose allowance is exposed to dilution when new agents enter, charging holders a small, visible penalty for each entry.
